title: Localization preserves universal injectivity
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $T\subseteq S$ a multiplicative subset, and $u:M\to M'$ a map of $S$-modules. Suppose $u$ is universally injective as an $R$-module map, that is, $L\otimes_R M\to L\otimes_R M'$ is injective for every $R$-module $L$. Then the localized map $T^{-1}u:T^{-1}M\to T^{-1}M'$ is universally injective as an $R$-module map. Localization is [def-weil-pbc-module-localization].
